name: harness-audit
description: Audit any repo's agent harness against four pillars and emit an executable rubric a loop can converge against, then ships the six loops that converge against it (stateless verification, skill learning, multi-agent review, deep verification, workflow improvement, operator session review) plus a zero-token telemetry dashboard. Ships write-time security guards (destructive-command gate, secret scan, no-verify block).
